correct_completion: the proposal was approved by a narrow margin.
full_sentence: Notwithstanding the committee's objections, the proposal was approved by a narrow margin.
acceptable_variants: the proposal still passed, though only just.
the board went ahead with it all the same.

options.text: the proposal was consequently rejected outright.
options.why_wrong: 'Consequently' marks a result, but the stem needs a contrasting main clause after 'notwithstanding', so this option does not complete the concessive frame.

options.text: because the committee had already voted in favour.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a reason and cannot open the main clause after 'notwithstanding'; the stem requires a contrast, not a cause.

options.text: the proposal was approved by a narrow margin.
so the objections were all withdrawn.
options.why_wrong: 'So' links the objections to a direct result, which does not express the contrast that 'notwithstanding' requires.

explanation: 'Notwithstanding' introduces a concession, so the main clause has to express an outcome that goes against what the objections would normally lead to. Turkish speakers may be tempted to add a result link after the concessive phrase because they expect the clause to read as a reason or a consequence, but English concessive expressions take a contrasting main clause instead.
translation: Komitenin itirazlarına rağmen, öneri dar bir farkla onaylandı.
